blocks.text: Emerging technologies naye auzaar, nizam aur tareeqe hain jo ban rahe ya naye istemal ho rahe hain: AI, cloud computing, blockchain, IoT, AR aur VR, quantum computing aur biotechnology waghaira. Cloud computing mein virtualization ek physical machine par kai virtual machines chalati, scalability zaroorat par wasail barhati, aur on-demand access unhein foran deti hai; IaaS infrastructure aur PaaS mukammal development platform deta hai. Blockchain mein nodes ka peer-to-peer network baghair markazi server ke ledger seedha share karta hai.
